text:
Samir Rao: Hey design ops  quick visual sprint for the Q2 bench launch. Need a compact asset pack: 1) single-page one-sheet (US Letter PDF) with a small dual-metric sparkline (latency vs $/1k) + micro 3-step inbound flow, 2) three-story social strip (3 panels, 1080x1080 each) telling latency -> cost -> recommended models, 3) email banner (600x200) and landing hero (1440x720). Keep brand palette only. Deadline: next Wed COB PT. Filenames below.
Elena Voss: Got it. Tone split? data-first for panel1, narrative for panel2, CTA panel3?
Samir Rao: Exactly. Panel1 = sparkline with dual y axes, panel2 = mini-table (top-3 models + per-1k cost), panel3 = big CTA + short lead routing diagram. One-sheet should have a tiny QR to the full benchmark doc.
Priya Rao: Sample series for the sparkline I'll use: latency_ms=[30,38,47,59,73,88], cost_per_1k=[0.52,0.41,0.29,0.20,0.11,0.06]. Prefer overlay if legible; else two small sparklines stacked. Alt text (<=240 chars): "Sparkline comparing latency (30ms to 88ms) and cost per 1k tokens ($0.52 to $0.06) across model variants."
brand-bot: Brand checklist  primary REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutrals only; fonts Inter (body) + GT Aligned (headings); max 2 typefaces; text contrast >=4.5:1; export @2x PNG/JPG and SVG for diagrams. Internal: https://brand/redwood-guidelines.
Jordan Li: Ops fields: registration needs hidden fields campaign=bench-sprint-q2, source=webinar, tag=benchkit. When score>=72 -> owner_pool=bench_sales. Sales wants default lead_priority=medium and lead_channel=product-web. I'll upload mapping CSV after assets are ready.
Elena Voss: Filenames for handoff: sprintq2_sheet_v1.pdf, sprintq2_social_panel1_1080.png, sprintq2_social_panel2_1080.png, sprintq2_social_panel3_1080.png, sprintq2_hero_1440x720.jpg, sprintq2_email_600x200.jpg. Figma: /brand/marketing/sprintq2.
Samir Rao: Accessibility: include tagged PDF, alt text, and longdesc in metadata. Include tiny 3-step mono-line diagram labeled: Register -> Ops score -> Book demo. Keep footer: "© Redwood Inference 2026  Internal benchmark summary" and small line: "Model data for internal use only."
Priya Rao: ETA: comps by Mon noon, revisions Tue, final Wed COB. Will @Samir when comps live. Thanks team :rocket:
